author: N6rL
content: Implemented alcanzai ingest CLI in alcanzai-interaction. ingest.py: run_ingest() covers full pipeline (source selection → resolve → job dir → fetch → artifact write → artifact_path injection → normalize → model_copy job_id → enrichment pipeline → atomic raw_document.json write → subprocess ingest-job → result.json parse → return ko_id). __main__.py: argparse with ingest subcommand, --library flag / ALCANZAI_LIBRARY env, catches SourceError + EnrichmentError + IngestError, exits 0 with ko_id on stdout. Binary location: ALCANZAI_BIN env → shutil.which('alcanzai'). 17 new tests (happy path, file assertions, subprocess args, artifact_path injection, job_id alignment, NoSourceError, subprocess failure, result.json errors, main() CLI). 162 total passing, 0 pyright errors. Mutation gate: deferred to #32.
